description: Check for categories using a specific software image (dependency check)
purpose: Validate that a software image can be safely deleted by checking for dependent categories

request.notes: BCM API does not support filtering by image - must query all and filter client-side

items.name: string (category name)
items.softwareimage: string (image NAME, not UUID) - FILTER ON THIS

filtering_logic.notes: softwareimage field contains IMAGE NAME (e.g., 'Rocky-8.10'), not UUID

error_message_format:
Software Image '{imageName}' cannot be deleted because it has {count} categor(ies) assigned.

Dependent categories:
  - {name} (uuid: {uuid})

Resolution options:
  1. Update categories to use a different software image before deleting
  2. Delete the dependent categories first (after removing their devices)
  3. Set 'force = true' to delete anyway (WARNING: will orphan category references)
implementation_notes: Always query all categories - BCM API does not support server-side filtering
Filter client-side by comparing category.softwareimage === targetImageName
IMPORTANT: softwareimage field is NAME (string), not UUID
Use image NAME from provider state, not UUID
Categories are typically small (< 100), so performance is not a concern
Empty array means no dependencies - safe to delete
